evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 杏花春馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上下天光之西折而南度橋為杏花春館西北為春雨軒軒西為杏花村村南為磵壑餘清春雨軒後東為鏡水齋西北室為抑齋又西為翠微堂（圓明園冊）臣等謹按杏花春館四十景之一也額為世宗御書館旁峰石上刋御製杏花春館詩春雨軒内額曰蕙氣清隂後厦聯曰生機對物觀其妙義府因心獲所寜與鏡水齋抑齋翠微堂諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: Across a bridge south-west of 上下天光: 杏花春館 with 春雨軒, 杏花村, 磵壑餘清, 鏡水齋, 抑齋 and 翠微堂. A Qianlong poem is cut in the rock beside it.

evidence.title: 镜水斋: 乾隆二十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十一年 (1756), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 形若菱花澄若空，妍媸不示自临中。无于水监于民监，周诰分明验异同。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 镜水斋, 1756. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 镜水斋: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 铜鉴衣冠正，人鉴善恶知。闲斋名镜水，清浊别于兹。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 镜水斋, 1761. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 镜水斋
evidence.locator: v2 p.31, under 杏花春馆; source ref 11-249
evidence.excerpt_zh: 朴斋近临沼，上下总含空。印月宁嫌冻，不波那碍风。宜吟真是趣，付物只由公。谁曰无于水，于民此正同。
evidence.summary: Poem 镜水斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1772, filed by the editors under 杏花春馆.

evidence.title: 镜水斋
evidence.locator: v2 p.34, under 杏花春馆; source ref 17-169
evidence.excerpt_zh: 水裔斋名镜，镜斋都借水。水固擅其能，镜斋则所尔。然而其所中，宾主又分矣。斋宾镜实主，炽然殊彼此。既思斋有实，镜乃虚名比。于此名实间，炙毂辨难拟。谁能去安排，忘言悟至理。
evidence.summary: Poem 镜水斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1790, filed by the editors under 杏花春馆.

evidence.title: 镜水斋: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 临水名斋水作镜，鉴已鉴人总持正。至清不可蔽浮尘，大圆内澈修本性。即境且为如是观，绿柳夭桃纷掩映。凭槛俯照见须眉，风光上已宜游咏。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 镜水斋, 1798. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 镜水斋
evidence.locator: from p.151, under 杏花春馆
evidence.summary: 镜水斋: 7 dated items, 1756-1798, of which 7 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing). First dated 1756, last dated 1798.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 杏花春馆
evidence.summary: First a vegetable plot, plaque of 1727. 春雨轩 was added in 1755; around it 涧壑余清, 得树亭, 杏花村, 土地庙, 镜水斋, 吟籁亭, the gate 渊镜/屏岩, 抑斋, 翠微堂, 绿云酣. The editors say 春雨轩 and others survived 1860, and were lost around 1900.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
